extends.description: Theme name or list of names. Later entries override earlier ones; this theme overrides all of them.

default.description: Applied to :root. Exactly one theme is default; a user theme with default:true replaces the built-in one.

auto.description: Also applied under prefers-color-scheme matching colorScheme when <html> has no data-theme.

seeds.description: Seed colors. Each becomes a 9-step palette (100–900, seed = 500), transparent.100–600 and contrast-derived roles (role.<name>.solid, .fg, .border, …). A new palette name must be added to the default theme; other themes then fall back to that seed.

shades.description: Explicit hex overrides per palette and step, e.g. { "brand": { "600": "#123456" } }.

tokens.description: Semantic tokens (nested). Values are literals or references such as {color.neutral.900}. Role tokens (role.<palette>.solid|fg|border|…) are derived automatically from seeds and surfaces; set one here to override it.

foundation.description: Overrides for foundation tokens (scale, radius, font, space, shadow, motion, …), same shape as foundation.json. Keys must already exist there. $coarse overrides apply under (pointer: coarse). Setting scale re-declares every derived token in the theme's scope.

contrast.description: Extra contrast rules (fg/bg are token paths). Built-in rules for text, borders, focus and every palette role always run.

$deprecated.description: Deprecated token paths mapped to a migration note. The build warns while a theme or foundation override still references them.
